title: Job interview
intro: Interviews test your English and your confidence. Learn to talk about experience with the right tense, show results with numbers, handle tricky questions and ask good questions yourself.
introBn: ইন্টারভিউতে ইংরেজি আর আত্মবিশ্বাস দুটোই দেখা হয়। সঠিক tense, সংখ্যা দিয়ে সাফল্য, কঠিন প্রশ্ন সামলানো আর নিজের প্রশ্ন করা শিখুন।

units.title: Talking about your experience
units.idea: Use the present perfect for experience up to now with no finished time (I've worked, I've led). Use the past simple for finished jobs and dates (I worked there in 2023). Give results with numbers.
units.ideaBn: এখন পর্যন্ত অভিজ্ঞতা বোঝাতে present perfect (I've worked)। নির্দিষ্ট অতীত সময় বা শেষ হওয়া চাকরিতে past simple (I worked in 2023)। ফলাফল সংখ্যা দিয়ে বলুন।

formula.name: Up to now
formula.pos: I've worked in sales for two years. · I've managed a team of five.

formula.name: Finished
formula.pos: I worked at BRAC from 2021 to 2023. · Last year I led a project.

formula.name: Results
formula.pos: I increased sales by 20%. · I cut response time from 2 days to 6 hours.

uses.rule: Present perfect + for/since for a job you still do.
uses.bn: এখনও করছেন এমন কাজে have + for/since।
uses.ex: I've been a software tester since 2023.

uses.rule: Past simple with finished time: in 2022, last year, ago.
uses.ex: I graduated from Rajshahi University in 2022.
I reduced customer complaints by 30% in six months.

uses.bn: responsible for এর পরে noun বা -ing।
uses.ex: I was responsible for training new staff.

uses.rule: Tell a short story: situation, action, result.
uses.ex: A client was unhappy, so I called him daily, and he renewed the contract.

traps.wrong: I have completed my graduation in 2022.
traps.why: Finished date needs past simple; 'complete graduation' is unnatural.
traps.bn: সাল থাকলে past simple; I graduated।

traps.wrong: I am working here for two years.
traps.right: I've been working here for two years.
traps.why: 'For' + up to now needs present perfect.
traps.bn: for দিয়ে এখন পর্যন্ত = have been।

traps.wrong: I was responsible to handle clients.
traps.right: I was responsible for handling clients.

drills.s: I ___ in customer service for three years, and I still enjoy it.
I ___ at a garments company in Gazipur from 2021 to 2023.
I increased online sales ___ 25% in one year.

drills.q: আমি ২০২২ সালে রাজশাহী বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে স্নাতক করেছি।
o: I graduated from Rajshahi University in 2022.
I have graduated from Rajshahi University in 2022.
I completed my graduation from Rajshahi University in 2022 year.
I was graduated Rajshahi University in 2022.
drills.a: I graduated from Rajshahi University in 2022.

o: I was good in my job.
I led a team of four and cut delivery delays by 40%.
drills.a: I led a team of four and cut delivery delays by 40%.

drills.s: In my last job, I was responsible ___ training new staff.
I've been a junior developer ___ March 2024.

o: I have joined the company last year.
I joined the company last year and have worked on three big projects since then.
I join the company last year.
I was joined the company last year.
drills.a: I joined the company last year and have worked on three big projects since then.
drills.x: Past for the date, present perfect for up to now.

units.title: Strengths, weaknesses, tricky questions and your questions
units.idea: Back up strengths with an example. Describe a real weakness and what you're doing about it. Buy time on hard questions, stay positive about past employers, and always ask the interviewer a question at the end.
units.ideaBn: শক্তির পক্ষে উদাহরণ দিন। একটা সত্যিকারের দুর্বলতা আর তা ঠিক করার চেষ্টা বলুন। কঠিন প্রশ্নে একটু সময় নিন, পুরনো অফিসের নিন্দা নয়, আর শেষে নিজেও প্রশ্ন করুন।

formula.name: Strength
formula.pos: One of my strengths is… · For example, …

formula.name: Weakness
formula.pos: I sometimes find it hard to… so I've started… · I'm working on…

formula.name: Time / ask
formula.pos: That's a good question. Let me think. · Could you tell me more about the team? · What would a typical day look like?

uses.rule: 'One of my strengths is' + noun or -ing.
uses.bn: One of my strengths is + noun/-ing।
uses.ex: One of my strengths is solving problems under pressure.

uses.rule: Weakness + action you're taking (present perfect / continuous).
uses.ex: I used to find public speaking hard, so I've joined a Toastmasters club.
That's a good question. Let me think for a moment.

uses.rule: Leave a job positively: looking for, want to grow.
uses.ex: I'm looking for a role with more international clients.

uses.rule: Ask about the role, team or next steps.
uses.bn: কাজ, দল বা পরের ধাপ নিয়ে প্রশ্ন।
uses.ex: What are the next steps in the process?

traps.wrong: My weakness is I am too perfect.
traps.right: I sometimes spend too long on details, so I now set time limits.

traps.wrong: My old boss was very bad, so I left.
traps.right: I'm looking for a role where I can grow.

traps.wrong: No, I don't have any question.
traps.right: Yes. Could you tell me how success is measured in this role?
traps.why: Having no questions suggests low interest.
traps.bn: প্রশ্ন না থাকলে আগ্রহ কম মনে হয়।

drills.s: One of my ___ is working well under pressure.

drills.q: Pick the best answer to 'What is your greatest weakness?'
o: I work too hard, that's all.
I sometimes find it hard to say no, so I've started using a task list to plan my week.
I am lazy in the morning.
drills.a: I sometimes find it hard to say no, so I've started using a task list to plan my week.

drills.s: That's a good question. Let me ___ about that for a second.

drills.q: আমি এমন একটা কাজ খুঁজছি যেখানে আমি আন্তর্জাতিক ক্লায়েন্টদের সাথে কাজ করতে পারব।
o: I'm looking for a role where I can work with international clients.
I am searching a job where I will can work with international clients.
I'm looking a role which I can work international clients.
I'm finding a job to work with foreign clients there.
drills.a: I'm looking for a role where I can work with international clients.

drills.q: Why did you leave your last job? Pick the best answer.
o: The salary was too low and my boss was rude.
I learned a lot there, but I'm ready for more responsibility.
drills.a: I learned a lot there, but I'm ready for more responsibility.

drills.s: What would a typical day ___ like in this role?
drills.x: What would a typical day look like?

drills.s: I'm ___ to discuss it, but I'd like to know more about the role first.

drills.q: Pick the best question to ask the interviewer.
o: How many holidays do I get?
Do I have to work hard?
How will success be measured in the first six months?
drills.a: How will success be measured in the first six months?

drills.s: I'm good at solving problems. ___ example, I fixed a billing error that saved 2 lakh taka.

mastery.s: I ___ three mobile apps since I joined my current company.
Two years ago, I ___ as an intern at a bank in Motijheel.

mastery.q: আমার একটা শক্তি হলো দলের সাথে কাজ করা।
o: One of my strengths is working in a team.
My one strength is work in team.
One of my strength is to working with team.
One strength of me is team working.
mastery.a: One of my strengths is working in a team.

o: What are the next steps in the process?
mastery.a: What are the next steps in the process?
mastery.x: Shows interest; you should already know what the company does.

o: I am doing this job since 2023.
I have doing this job since 2023.
I have been doing this job since 2023.
mastery.a: I have been doing this job since 2023.
